answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 42593 Country: Bangladesh Title: Learning Quran and Hadith without the permission of parents Question: I am a computer science engineer. I want to go to madrasa to learn Quran and Hadith, but my parents are not permitting me. What does Islam say if I go to madrasa without the permission of my parents when they are not dependent upon my income or any other support as I have another elder brother. Answer ID: 42593 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1705/1705/M=1433) There is no need of parents’ permission for learning the necessary knowledge of religion. We do not know why your parents do not allow you for the same. If they stop you from going out of your place then you should learn it staying at your city. Also try to motivate your parents with good conduct and wisdom. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
